text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: multiple decode/streaming pods reporting CUDA OOM and container restarts on gpu-decode-pool. Request drops observed. PD ticket PD-9032 opened.

pagerduty: Severity: P1. Escalating to oncall.

alex: oncall here, looking. seeing repeated `cudaMalloc` failures in logs, count rising. taking ownership.

maria: sending quick triage — are we seeing runaway generation (client-supplied max_tokens) or internal misconfig? any header bypass noted?

sam: logs show a couple of long tail requests with token bursts. found traces where header `X-Client-Max-Tokens: 10000` passed through due to an old proxy rule. sample log:```
E decode_worker.cpp:431 cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
E stream_dispatcher.cpp:289 token_count=9201, kv_cache_bytes=12.3GB
```

lucy: Support: customers A and C reported mid-generation truncation + errors, CS tickets open (TCK-871, TCK-872). CS notified enterprise customers on rotation.

james: I can draft an interim message but need impact numbers. alex can you confirm which routes affected?

alex: routing: /v1/stream and /v1/chat/stream primarily. about 8% error rate on decode cluster for the last 6m.

maria: mitigation plan (short):
- isolate offending nodes (drain/cordon)
- apply router-level enforcement to cap tokens for streaming routes
- temporarily enable fallback model with smaller KV footprint

sam: executing router hotpatch: setting `enforce-max-tokens=true` for svc=redwood-proxy on prod-edge. command:```
kubectl -n redwood patch configmap proxy-config -p '{"data":{"enforce-max-tokens":"true","max-tokens-default":"512"}}' && kubectl rollout restart deployment/proxy -n redwood
```

alex: cordoning node gpu-decode-09:```
kubectl cordon gpu-decode-09 && kubectl drain gpu-decode-09 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data -n redwood
```

sam: started routing patch, will monitor. also spinning up warm fallback pool using quantized model q4f32 to reduce memory per KV.

maria: tagging this as potential customer impact. please add any affected account IDs to PD ticket.

lucy: added TCK-871/872 and account ids to PD-9032. CS sending targeted notice to A/C now. :email:

alex: after cordon and router patch error rate dropped to ~1.2% in 4m. some pods still evicting on restart, investigating residual fragmentation.

sam: also removed the legacy proxy rule that allowed `X-Client-Max-Tokens` passthrough. rule id `proxy-rule-legacy-42` deleted. verified header is no longer forwarded.

james: drafting customer note: short summary + mitigation + ETA for RCA. will share in ~15m.

maria: followups:
- RCA owner: sam
- Runbook update: add step to deny client max-tokens header at edge and add telemetry for token header usage
- Postmortem due in 3 business days

alex: marking incident as contained. continuing to monitor for 30m. handoff to oncall rotation tomorrow.

incident-bot: User reaction :thumbsup: — incident contained. PD ticket PD-9032 updated.

lucy: CS: customers A and C confirmed degraded experience but no data loss. they appreciate fast mitigation.

sam: RCA notes (quick): root cause = legacy proxy rule letting extremely large `max_tokens` values circumvent service-side caps causing KV cache growth -> cudaMalloc OOM -> container crashes. fix = router enforcement + remove legacy rule + fallback quantized model.

james: will schedule postmortem and coordinate any release notes.

maria: closing thread for now. reopen if error rate climbs >2% again. :white_check_mark:
